description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterObject class, which provides the implementation for the Smarty::registerObject() method. The class contains a method to register PHP objects to be used inside Smarty templates, including validation of allowed methods and block methods.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterObject
classes.description: Class that implements the registerObject() method to register PHP objects with Smarty templates, including validation for allowed methods and block methods.

methods.name: registerObject
methods.description: Registers a PHP object to be accessible within Smarty templates, validating allowed methods and block methods, and storing the object along with its configuration.
